Kyoto Nightlife

Kyoto’s nightlife is very different to Tokyo’s, it’s more laid-back vibes. It’s got riverside drinks, sake tastings, rooftop bars, and sento visits instead of clubs and big parties.

Places we went:
In the Moon (Rooftop Bar)
📍200 RF Nakanocho, Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto, 605-0075

📍Kamo River

Makoto-no-yu (Public Bath)

Since its humble post-WW2 beginnings, Japanese Americana has grown into a huge movement thanks to its commitment to craftsmanship and thoughtfulness. 

The best denim and leather jackets in the world now come from Japan as many brands prioritize authenticity and quality over expanding for profits.

Here are some of my favourite shops in Tokyo to get you started.

Follow for more.

#americana #denim #jeans #leatherjacket #tokyo #japan #tokyofashion #japanfashion #thrifting".
transcription: So you're in Tokyo and want to buy a Americana. Here is where you should go. Noya in Weno is the ultimate destination for Danny Mads. Known as the best jeans shop in the world, you find most local Danny brands here. My personal favorite is Big John. The brand has created the first fully made in Japan, paired in history. They also stocked a white sweet t-shirt worn by Jeremy Allen White in the bear, and have great leather jackets. Motu in Aoyama is a small leather brand epitomizing understated and well-made craftsmanship. They have a large selection of shoes, loafers and boots that will last you a lifetime. I have a pair of their sandals and I use them a lot every summer. Their leather jackets are also fantastic. The real mechoy is in a Motesando is the Crème de la Crème. They specialize in reproductions of American clothing from the 40s and 50s, using the same methods and machinery from the past. Their attention to detail and quality is unmatched. They make the best leather jackets, crappy and military clothes around with no compromises. Follow for more.

This was one of the most unique meals I’ve had in Tokyo. You’re served both tsukemen and sukiyaki, with 2 choices of dipping sauce for your noodles. I went with the pork bone seafood, and shrimp 🦐 ones, but there was a garlic soy sauce, and sesame paste chilli oil option too. 

And if you’re looking to jump the queue, it’s 750 yen only - which is worth it imo to see more of Japan! 

📍Aidaya, Ueno, Tokyo

#sukiyaki #tsukemen #tokyo #tokyoeats #ueno #東京 #上野 #上野グルメ #つけ麺  #すき焼き #uptoknowjapanfood".
transcription: This is truly a one of a kind sokiyaki noodle spot in Tokyo. It's all prepared in front of you and get this for a small price. You can even skip the queue.
